audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows printed Lucian while their own why said the opposite: whys[1] opens 'Even at 2', whys[2] describes 'the first trade his poke can't answer', whys[3] says 'I trade around his cooldowns and bank small leads', whys[4] says 'All Out is a coin-flip at 6'. Rows 1-4 read Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Lucian against that.
audit.why: 48.69% over 2563 games, and the packet chart (Lucian, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill, Skill, Lucian) agrees with the prose line for line.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 set to Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill in phases[].side and win[] together, ratings re-scaled to 5/6/6/5. Rows 0, 5 and 6 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit — the cooldown the entire page is built around tracking — was described only as 'His dash + reset' with no duration, and the reset condition was never explained.
audit.why: It is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, the longest thing in his kit, BUT Lightslinger attacks reduce it. A reader counting a 16s clock while he double-shots the wave will step up into a dash that is already back.
audit.corrected: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s written into the interactions row, the cooldown block and dosFull[0].d, each time paired with 'count his casts, not the clock'. Piercing Light's 9/8/7/6/5s at 500 range and The Culling's 110/100/90s added.
sources: kit: Lucian E 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 with 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'

audit.whatIsWrong: (1) 'Q3 knockup-pull' / 'Q3 knockup' in five paths — Ntofo Strikes has no knockup and no third cast; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls. (2) 'W (Path Maker)'s unstoppable charge' and 'a charged W is unstoppable through his slows' — Riot's text says reduced damage taken while charging, never unstoppable. Telling a reader they cannot be stopped mid-charge by a champion whose whole kit is disengage is the worst possible version of this error. (3) The packet flags that the page never names a single Lucian ability.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority; unstoppable status is not in the file, so it is unknown.
audit.corrected: Pull named correctly, W described as a damage-reduced charge, and Lightslinger, Piercing Light and Relentless Pursuit written into the early/mid prose and the wants rows so the abilities are actually named.
sources: kit: K'Sante Q text 'At 2 stacks ... pulls enemies in'
kit: K'Sante W text 'charges up, taking reduced damage'

edits.before: Lucian owns level 1-2 here — I only have my Q (Ntofo Strikes) cleave and no engage threat, so his passive double-shot and Q/W poke chip me down while I just farm and concede the first level. Don't try to fight under his harass; soak the wave at Q range and stack my passive marks off any auto I can land. The moment that flips is level 3: with my full Q-W combo I can W (Path Maker) charge into him through his E dash and Q3 the knockup-pull for a real trade he can't poke his way out of.
edits.after: Lucian owns level 1-2 here — I only have my Q (Ntofo Strikes) cleave and no engage threat, so his Lightslinger double-shot and Piercing Light poke chip me down while I just farm and concede the first level. Don't try to fight under his harass; soak the wave at Q range and stack my passive marks off any auto I can land. The moment that flips is level 3: with my full Q-W combo I can W (Path Maker) charge into him and land the two-stack Ntofo pull for a real trade he can't poke his way out of.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 are my lane-control peak. He has to walk into my range to CS, and a charged W (Path Maker) is unstoppable through his slows, so I bank small leads by W-stunning him into Q3 whenever he steps up. The key is patience: bait his E dash first, because if he saves it he slips my W and re-kites my short range. At 6 it goes even — All Out gives me a duelist profile to win the 1v1, but it strips my bulk, so I only commit when I can land W and close, never as a raw stat-check into his double-shot.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 are my lane-control peak. He has to walk into my range to CS, and a charged W (Path Maker) takes reduced damage through his poke, so I bank small leads by W-stunning him into the two-stack pull whenever he steps up. The key is patience: bait Relentless Pursuit first, because if he saves it he slips my W and re-kites my short range. At 6 it goes even — All Out gives me a duelist profile to win the 1v1, but it strips my bulk, so I only commit when I can land W and close, never as a raw stat-check.

notes: REJECTED two supplied missing-interactions as tooltip-parsing misfires. Lightslinger's shield and heal flags come from the clause 'When Lucian is healed or SHIELDED BY AN ALLY' — that is a condition that empowers his attacks, not Lucian shielding or healing himself, so neither 'Lucian sustains through chip damage' nor 'Lightslinger absorbs your burst window' is true and neither was written. The autoreset flag IS real (an ability cast makes his next attack a double-shot) and is now the tell in the cooldown block. No mirror existed for lucian__ksante; this file defines the chart that side must invert: Lucian, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill, Skill, Lucian.
